runs.content: Deere & Company picked up at today's close ($690.46) — Baird upgraded to Outperform ($800 PT from $640), corn/soy futures +22% YTD (genuine ag-cycle tailwind), Q3 FY26 beat-and-raise (rev $12.61B, EPS $5.10); all-time-high Dow 30 momentum name entered on a broad market rally (S&P +0.51%, Dow +0.93%) despite the 10Y Treasury yield hitting 5.18%, highest since the financial crisis. OTIS was exited discretionarily (−8.42%, −$84) on a genuine thesis break — Otis cut its FY26 operating-profit outlook alongside a Q2 revenue beat and kept grinding to fresh 52-week lows through September — freeing capacity for DE and holding the book at 35 open positions. NOC (−6.84%, no Burry conflict) is now the weakest continuing position. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,622 (+2.42% on $67,000).

Wise plc picked up at today's previous close (845.60 GBX, ~$11.28) — mf-rank-1 Value screen (PE ~24.7x, ROIC 389%, earnings yield 14.4%), down ~22.6% over the past year to near a 52-week low, 19-analyst Buy consensus with 37% upside to a 1,161p target; entered on a second consecutive risk-off session (10Y Treasury yield pushing toward 5.2%, highest since 2004 on the 30Y, on a strong ISM PMI report). CMCSA was exited discretionarily (−6.89%, −$69) to keep the book at 35 open positions after WISE's entry — weakest position in the book, no distinct catalyst break. HUM improved to −9.11%, back off the −10% WATCH line. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,763 (+2.67% on $66,000).
